strategy.thesis: Venture arm of the Ontario Municipal Employees Retirement System (OMERS); the only pension fund in the world doing direct early-stage venture. Fund IV is a US$750M transatlantic fund; in 2025 OMERS Ventures refocused on Canada with $5–25M tickets.

summary.en: Launched in 2011 as the venture arm of Ontario pension giant OMERS, OMERS Ventures was Canada's first pension-backed direct VC. Its US$750M Fund IV invests Series A–C ($5–25M cheques) across Canada, the US and Europe; backers of Shopify, Hopper, Wave and Wattpad.
